title: Claims Manual Schedule: Death Claim Interest and Beneficiary Limits for Whole Life Insurance
content:
Death claim interest, the smallest share for an Ashgrove Beneficiary Access Account and the limits on beneficiary designations are fixed for every Whole Life Insurance tier as follows.

| Tier | Interest on death proceeds (annual rate, simple, from the date of death to disbursement) | Smallest payee share that may be settled into an Ashgrove Beneficiary Access Account (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Final Expense Whole Life | 3.5% (0.035) | 5000 |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100 | 3.5% (0.035) | 10000 |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 65 | 3.5% (0.035) | 10000 |
| Ashgrove 20-Pay Whole Life | 3.5% (0.035) | 10000 |
| Ashgrove 10-Pay Whole Life | 3.5% (0.035) | 10000 |
| Ashgrove Single Premium Whole Life | 3.5% (0.035) | 10000 |

| Designation figure (every tier) | Value |
|---|---|
| Maximum number of primary beneficiaries | 10 |
| Smallest beneficiary share; shares are whole percents | 1 percent |
| Age below which a share is paid only to a guardian or UTMA custodian | 18 years |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- A payee share of 10000 dollars on a 10-Pay policy may be settled into a Beneficiary Access Account; a share of 9999.99 dollars may not. On a Final Expense policy the smallest such share is 5000 dollars.
- A designation naming 11 primary beneficiaries exceeds the maximum of 10.
- A beneficiary aged 17 is below 18, so that share is paid only to a court-appointed guardian or UTMA custodian.
